title: Dilation calculus: pull-back of test forms, push-forward of currents, commutation with ∂
statement: Dilation calculus on ℝ^N (Simon Ch. 6, 2.23 and 2.24(1) for η_ρ(x) = ρx). Let N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ. Test forms are elements of TestFormOn univ (C^∞, compact support) and currents are elements of GeometricCurrentOn univ, on ℝ^N = Eucl N. Then: (1) for every test k-form ω there is a test k-form η with η(x) = ρ^k ω(ρx) for all x; (2) for every X ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) there is Y ∈ D_k(ℝ^N) with Y(ω) = X(η) for all test k-forms ω, η satisfying η(x) = ρ^k ω(ρx) for all x; (3) if X, Y ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^N) satisfy Y(ω) = X(η) for all test (k+1)-forms ω, η with η(x) = ρ^{k+1} ω(ρx) for all x, then ∂Y(ω) = ∂X(η) for all test k-forms ω, η with η(x) = ρ^k ω(ρx) for all x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ k : ℕ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) ∧ (∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η)) ∧ ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (k + 1), (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) (k + 1), (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) (k + 1)) x = ρ ^ (k + 1) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) (k + 1)) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → ∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y.boundary ω = X.boundary η
